summary: Introduce a tenant-scoped publication quality engine, immutable evidence and exact preflight receipts without moving source-of-truth ownership from catalog, inventory, compliance or connectors.

impacts.evidence: Profiles, runs, issues and receipts carry organization/workspace scope and are forced-RLS tenant data.
Evidence is bounded to safe identifiers, versions and digests; raw payloads, credentials, media and unnecessary PII are excluded.
The quality read/evaluate surface is additive under /api/v1 and must be represented in the OpenAPI contract.
No canonical event envelope is changed; later worker triggers use the existing EventBus/outbox contract.
Connector profiles expose declarative capabilities while preserving the existing provider-neutral SDK boundary.
Migration 33 is additive, checksummed, tenant-scoped and includes forced RLS plus append-only terminal evidence.
Profile rules are typed and bounded, media requires security release, and receipt checks fail closed before egress.
Approval-required compliance or policy outcomes never produce a publishable receipt or bypass Task-017 policy.
Runs retain immutable source/profile digests, issues and gate receipts for reproducible operator evidence.
Receipt identity and snapshot versions make retries exact-match and stale writes rejectable.
The local quality engine performs no remote call and stores no webhook or provider response.
Decision, issue-category, freshness, denial-reason and evaluation-latency metrics are defined for the quality gate.
The expand-only schema can be retained while callers disable the gate; source-of-truth tables are untouched.
Deterministic domain tests cover decisions, score/order, stale receipts, unsafe profiles and tenant isolation.
